summary: Opening of the Ansible Developer Guide, explaining it is for people extending Ansible with custom modules or plugins, and listing use-case entry points such as adding a local plugin, developing or contributing to collections, and migrating roles.
questions: Is the developer guide the right place if I just want to use a custom module locally?
Where do I start if I want to turn a role into a collection?
How do I decide whether writing a module is the right approach?
